headline: Dangote Refinery Plans $1.6B IPO on Nigerian Exchange
summary: A planned $1.6 billion initial public offering of the Dangote Petroleum Refinery could expand Nigeria's active investor base up to fivefold, according to the NGX CEO.
why: Dangote Refinery is Africa's largest oil refinery; its listing would be a major landmark for Nigerian capital market liquidity.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: A landmark $1.6B refinery listing significantly boosts capital market turnover and retail investor participation.
